entities.name: Jaya Ballard

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the White Shield.

entities.name: Shauku

entities.name: Afari

entities.name: Jolrael

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Leader of the Knights of Stromgald.

entities.description: Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Kaervek

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Kjeldoran royal mage.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Balduvian Chieftain.

entities.name: Telim'Tor

entities.name: Liefellen
entities.description: Quirion exarch.

entities.name: Rana
entities.description: Suq'Ata market fool.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: Elder Druid of the Juniper Order.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Sarpadian mercenary.

entities.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
entities.description: Speaker of the last words about the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Hans
entities.description: Companion warned to run from the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Aline Corralurn
entities.description: Author of the poem Late Thaw.

entities.name: Gulsen
entities.description: Abbey Matron.

entities.name: Order of the White Shield
entities.description: An order led by Lucilde Fiksdotter.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: A group led by Avram Garrisson who believe Kjeldorans should rule supreme.

entities.name: Juniper Order
entities.description: Order of druids with Kolbjörn as Elder Druid.

entities.name: Shadow Guild
entities.description: A guild whose maxim concerns keeping the dead so others may live.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship captained by Sisay.

entities.name: Amiqat
entities.description: City whose vizier Qhattib and trader Grahilah are named.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Land that Jolrael may betray.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Homeland of Kjeldorans and a royal mage.

entities.name: Balduvian
entities.description: People led by Chieftain Lovisa Coldeyes.

entities.name: Quirion
entities.description: Elves with an exarch, Liefellen.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: People whose market fool Rana is quoted.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: People of whom Naimah is a philosopher.

entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: Land whose children share a rhyme.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Land that Ivra Jursdotter hails from.

entities.name: Lhurgoyf

entities.name: Efreet
entities.description: A fiery creature described as a striding storm.

events.summary: Ertai says he is too modest to reveal his abilities.
events.quote: "I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities."

events.summary: Qhattib describes the efreet.
events.quote: "The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."

events.summary: Jaya Ballard describes the result of her fire as toast.
events.quote: "Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."

events.summary: Teferi remarks on controlling time.
events.quote: "Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."

events.summary: Lucilde Fiksdotter says Barbarians will respect honor over military might.
events.quote: "The so-called Barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."

events.summary: Shauku compares politics to a game where the stones bleed.
events.quote: "Politics is a game—move a stone here, move a stone there—except sometimes the stones bleed."

events.summary: Afari's Tales recount people leaving a barren land to hyenas and vipers.
events.quote: "The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."

events.summary: Jolrael's choice of home is noted as better than her allies.
events.quote: Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.

events.summary: Avram Garrisson proclaims Kjeldoran supremacy.
events.quote: "Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"

events.summary: Naimah warns that beauty to the eye does not translate to touch.
events.quote: "Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."

events.summary: Jolrael reflects on the horrors Kaervek freed and her coming betrayal.
events.quote: "I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."

events.summary: Gustha Ebbasdotter speaks of water moving the land and holding fires captive.
events.quote: "Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within."

events.summary: Jaya Ballard jokes about pyroblast against water mages.
events.quote: "Just the thing for those pesky water mages."

events.summary: Sisay says angering the gods turns clouds against you.
events.quote: "You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."

events.summary: Grahilah says you do not need what you were not born with.
events.quote: "If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes vows the Balduvians would sting their enemies even in ash.
events.quote: "Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."

events.summary: Jaya Ballard offers toast.
events.quote: "Anybody want some . . . *toast*?"

events.summary: Telim'Tor advises never stopping until the lance comes out the other side.
events.quote: "Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."

events.summary: Naimah describes her new home among flowers.
events.quote: "My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen."

events.summary: Liefellen advises respecting the earth.
events.quote: "Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."

events.summary: Afari's Tales tell of a snake's hiss for peace lost under the elephant's war trumpet.
events.quote: "But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."

events.summary: Rana asks whether apes wear furs of gold when they marry.
events.quote: "Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"

events.summary: Jolrael prefers a centaur to cavalry.
events.quote: "What need have I for cavalry when I can have horse and rider both in one?"

events.summary: Kolbjörn says Elves and druids serve the same goddess.
events.quote: "Living side by side with the Elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess."

events.summary: Ivra Jursdotter recalls an ogre turning on its commander.
events.quote: "We were holding our own—until the ogre guiding us suddenly grinned and turned on our commander."

events.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter shouts a warning about the lhurgoyf as her last words.
events.quote: "Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"

events.summary: Gulsen reports guardian Bears or spirits on caravan routes.
events.quote: "I hear there are Bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest."
